predict: LOGICOL stands for Logically-Informed Contrastive Learning for Set-based Dense Retrieval. It is a logically-informed contrastive learning framework or objective used for retrieval tasks, particularly for dense retrievers. LOGICOL incorporates logical constraints and is designed to work with queries containing logical connectives. It builds upon inbatch supervised contrastive learning and is used to train models for retrieval tasks, resulting in cleaner separation in query embedding representations.
